title: rubus infrarugosus
intro: Rubus infrarugosus, commonly known as the Himalayan raspberry or Tibetan raspberry, is a species of bramble that belongs to the rose family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include lowering blood sugar levels, reducing inflammation, and aiding in weight management. The therapeutic actions of Rubus infrarugosus are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
